string.text: Psy Stress Remake 0.8.7 - made by Expand. Based on Psy Stress 1.06.04 by livvan.
\n Uses 'Campfire psy regeneration' instead of 'Campfire stress reduction'.
\n Gallucination phantoms begin to appear when the psy health is below a %, which is configured in the Stress Stages menu item.

Classic: standard ghost phantoms appear near you.
 Realistic mutants: phantoms look like real mutants (dogs, snorks, fractures and others), run at you from a distance and vanish from one hit. Requires the "Phantoms at low psy health" (xcvb) and "Maybelline's Restore XCV phantoms" mods (both in G.A.M.M.A.), otherwise classic phantoms are used.
 Both use the Psy Stress phantom threshold, delay and max count. The automatic spawning of the xcvb mod is turned off.

Enables alternative usage of psy-protection against psy-attacks.
 Psy-protection is used as procetile reduction instead of flat subtractin from psy-damge.
 Reduces instanced when some psy damages are zero, while others are barely effected.
\n Enables the chance that after death from psy damage the player character rises as a zombie.
\n Removes voice effects on low psy health for compatibility with other player character sound mods.
\n Works in combination with the enabled Anomaly debug mode, generates verbose logs for the Psy Stress script.
\n Basic psy regeneration, is added when other stress recovering effects are present.
\n Basic drain of psy health due to stress, enviromental modifiers affect this value. Can be adjusted in the environmental evaluation menu item.
Psy stress on receving damage (X% of damage)
\n % of physical damage that turns into psy damage due to the pain.
Psy stress from being wounded (for 10% of hp lost X% in 10 minutes)
\n Ongoing psy drain due to existing wounds. For each 10% of health lost X% drain of psy health in 10 minutes).

Selecting a preset moves the psy drain, psy stress on receiving damage, psy stress from wounds, Controller psy damage and psy anomaly damage sliders to the preset values (press Accept to apply). You can fine-tune the sliders afterwards.
 Uneasy is the mildest preset (3x original Psy Stress), Nightmare the hardest (15x). Default: Harsh (8x).
 Controller psy damage: 30% / 40% / 50% / 75% / 100%. Psy anomaly damage: 10% / 20% / 35% / 45% / 70% of base G.A.M.M.A.

Selecting a preset moves the basic psy regeneration and campfire regeneration sliders to the preset values (press Accept to apply). You can fine-tune the sliders afterwards.
 Steady is the original Psy Stress regeneration (the easiest preset); Shaken, Fragile and Broken are slower (0.7x, 0.3x, 0.1x).
 Psy boosters (Psy-Block etc.), psy-protecting artefacts, sleep and surge cover recovery follow the basic regeneration slider. Anabiotic always restores psy health fully.
\n The distance from the central point of a camp to the player. The player is considered to be in a camp when closer than this value. Camps with only hostile factions spawns are considered not safe.
\n The distance at which the comforting effect from an active campfire gets applied.
\n The distance from the central point of a static anomaly at which the unnerving effect from being in an anomalous zone gets applied.

\n Psy drain recovery from being in a safe cover. Calculation of the resulting value: (100 - X)%.\n A negative value would mean psy health recovery. For example (100-125)% = -25%, 25% of psy drain will be recovering.

Psy drain recovery from being in a non-hostile camp. Applied in camps with frienldy or neutral faction spawns.
 Calculation of the resulting value: (100 - X)%.
 A negative value would mean psy health recovery. For example (100-125)% = -25%, 25% of psy drain will be recovering.

Psy drain recovery from being around a burning campfire. NOT applied if 'Use Cozy Campfires by Voland33' is enabled.
 Calculation of the resulting value: (100 - X)%.
 A negative value would mean psy health recovery. For example (100-125)% = -25%, 25% of psy drain will be recovering.
\n Psy drain increase while being in underground locations. A negative value would mean stress reduction.
\n Psy drain increase from being in a static anomalous zone.
\n Psy drain increase from being around an active anomaly.
\n Psy drain increase from being in combat.
\n Psy drain increase from being hungry, will be mutiplyed by the current level of hunger.
\n Psy drain increase from dehydration, will be mutiplyed by the current level of dehydration.
\n Psy drain increase from being lack of sleep, will be mutiplyed by the current level of sleepness.
\n Psy regeneration from being near a campfire gets applied if Cozy Campfires by Voland33 is enabled. Disables 'Campfire stress reduction'.
First stage of stress (X% of psy health)
\n Below this psy health % the screen gets blurry (strength: 'Screen blur strength').
Second stage of stress (X% of psy health)

\n Below this psy health % sounds get muffled, stronger the lower your psy health. Only works when 'Compatibility with voice/sound mods' is off; the blur stays the same. Must be lower than the first stage.
\n How strong the screen blur is at the first and second stage of stress. 100% = original blur, 0% = no blur.
\n Audial gallucinations (sure they are gallucinations?) start at this psy health %.
\n Maximum volume of audial gallucinations. Audial hallutionations will reach this volume at 20% of psy health.
\n Minimal volume of audial gallucinations. Audial hallutionations will start this volume at 'Voices start' level psy health.
\n Visual gallucinations start at this psy health %.
\n The probability that a player character will turn into a zombie instead of dying from psy damage.
Multiplier for Controller psy damage (X% of original)
\n Balances the damage from a Controller psy attack. Gets applied after psy protection effects, to preserve them unchanged.\n Set by the psy damage preset (Harsh: 50%).

\n Psy damage from psy anomalies (psy fields, other psy anomalies and the psy aura of Dynamic Anomalies Overhaul / Arrival). 100% = the damage of base G.A.M.M.A., calculated by G.A.M.M.A.'s Actor Damage Balancer with its psy protection; 0% = no damage.\n Set by the psy damage preset (from 10% on Uneasy to 70% on Nightmare, Harsh: 35%). Psy emitters (Brain Scorcher, X16, Radar), psi-storms and mutants are not affected.
Controller Psy attack MAX hit distance (meters)

If the distance is more than the max. distance, the Controller psy attack deals 0 damage.
 If the distance is 0.1 from the max. distance, the Controller psy attack deals full damage.
 After 0.1 from the max. distance, the damage is linearly reduced down to 10% at max. distance.
